title: Tracked hook files hold one form on every host
when: Someone renders the Yoke repository's own Claude or Cursor hook files (yoke agents render) on native Windows, or an installed project refreshes hooks on a different OS than wrote them.
need: Repository-rendered hook files are POSIX (/bin/sh) on every host (decision 15934); Claude Code runs them through Git Bash on Windows. Machine-local user hooks and installed projects use the native Windows form, a bare `yoke hook evaluate <Verb> --harness <id> [--config-owner <owner>]` that cmd, PowerShell and Git Bash all run through the bin shim on PATH, with no PowerShell wrapper; `yoke hook evaluate` sets the root, identity and owner itself. Codex keeps that form in its separate commandWindows field, which the installing client composes on every host (the server bundle sends POSIX commands only). The retired PowerShell -EncodedCommand form is still recognised so refresh and setup replace it. Install and refresh recognise a Yoke entry written in the other shell form by matcher, verb and config owner, and replace it in place instead of adding a duplicate.
surface: agents render drift check, machine hook setup and project install hook merge.
review: Source tests pin POSIX repository render under a simulated Windows host, native machine and installed-project rendering, and cross-form convergence.
